how_to_order: Photograph the broken latch, or the empty latch position on the door, with a coin or ruler in the shot.
Send photos on the request page, say whether the door is left or right hand, and add the model number if you have it. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.q: Will it fit my camper screen door?
faqs.a: If your latch looks like a paddle or lever style used on Forest River and similar doors, we match it from photos. We confirm the fit with you before printing.

faqs.q: Is a printed latch as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed ASA is strong in most directions but weakest where the layers pull apart, so we orient the print to put the main load along the layers. We tell you if a part looks like a poor candidate.

faqs.q: How do I measure or photograph the latch?
faqs.a: Photograph the latch from the front, side and back on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it. Tell us if the door is left hand or right hand, and measure the distance between the screw holes if you can. Send the model number if there is one.

faqs.q: Do you make the spring too?
faqs.a: We print the plastic paddle and lever parts. Springs are metal, so we typically suggest reusing yours or buying a small spring locally, and we will say so in the quote.

faqs.q: Can I order a left and right pair?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us how many of each hand you need and we quote a lower price per latch.
